name: vision-ocr
title: Vision OCR
description: Local OCR for clipboard, image, and PDF files using macOS Apple Vision.
author: yshalsager

commands.name: ocr-clipboard
commands.title: Extract Text from Clipboard
commands.description: Replace the current clipboard image or copied file with recognized text.

commands.name: ocr-options
commands.title: Extract Text with Options
commands.description: Run OCR with one-off source, language, speed, and output options.

commands.name: ocr-selected
commands.title: Extract Text from Selected Files
commands.description: Run local Apple Vision OCR on the selected Finder files.

preferences.name: primary_language
preferences.title: Primary Language
preferences.description: Main language to prefer for OCR.

preferences.name: extra_languages
preferences.title: Extra Languages
preferences.description: Optional additional BCP-47 tags, separated by commas. Example: en-US, ar

preferences.name: level
preferences.title: Recognition Level
preferences.description: Choose whether Vision should prefer accuracy or speed.

preferences.name: output_action
preferences.title: Clipboard Command Output
preferences.description: Choose what the clipboard command does with recognized text.
